description: TI mmw demo, one binary per board (Firmware/IWR_Demos; firmware_dev ti_stock_demos for 1843/6843): TLV point cloud over the serial data port; on 1843/6843 raw ADC over LVDS to a DCA1000 is enabled by the cfg (lvdsStreamCfg), not by a separate firmware. The 1443 demo has no LVDS output.

lvds_data_fmts.source: firmware_dev/projects/ti_stock_demos SDK 3.6 xwr68xx mmw include/mmw_config.h + mss/mmw_lvds_stream.c:649-652 (valid dataFmt 0 disabled, 1 ADC, 4 CP_ADC_CQ; the CLI does not range-check, the stream code handles only 1 and 4)

n_tx.source: docs/research/gui_board_limits_single_chip.md row 1: DS Table; max 2 simultaneous per chirp (SYS_14xx, RL:925)

band_subranges_ghz.source: docs/research/gui_board_limits_single_chip.md row 3: a sweep must lie wholly inside one sub-band (RL:667-668)

max_slope_mhz_us.source: docs/research/gui_board_limits_single_chip.md row 4: datasheet ramp rate (DS14 5.7 / DS18 7.7 / DS68 7.9); RL:710,713

max_sample_rate_ksps.source: docs/research/gui_board_limits_single_chip.md row 5: complex-1x, regular ADC mode (RL:742-757; IWR1843 12500 per datasheet IF 10 MHz, user ruling 2026-10-06)

lowpower_max_ksps.source: docs/research/gui_board_limits_single_chip.md (correction section; rl_sensor.h L742-767): applies only when the cfg selects low-power ADC mode (lowPower <x> 1); API doc, not datasheet

min_chirp_cycle_us.source: docs/research/gui_board_limits_single_chip.md row 7: chirp cycle (idle + rampEnd) minimum, RL:651-654, RL:4570-4573; +10 us if the watchdog is on (xWR1xxx), not modelled

min_frame_blank_us.source: docs/research/gui_board_limits_single_chip.md row 16: inter-frame blank typically >= 300 us (+150 us if the profile changes); RL:978-987

adc_buffer_bytes.source: docs/research/gui_board_limits_single_chip.md row 9: SOC_XWR14XX_MSS_ADCBUF_SIZE 0x4000 (SYS14:312); DS14 diagram says 2x16KB, ping/pong split unresolved

l3_radar_cube_bytes.source: docs/research/gui_board_limits_single_chip.md row 10: 384 KB max radar data memory (DS14 Table 6-1, MAK14:14,18-19); shipped SDK 2 split unverifiable; demo only (DPC:1817 ENOMEM)

lvds_lane_mbps.source: docs/research/gui_board_limits_single_chip.md row 12: DCA1000 max and demo/SAR program 0x9 = 600 (silicon allows 900)

channel_cfg_args.source: shipped single-chip cfgs: channelCfg rx tx cascading

fields.label: Mode
fields.help: CFAR averaging: CA, CAGO (greatest-of) or CASO (smallest-of).

fields.label: Noise window
fields.help: Noise cells averaged next to the cell under test.

fields.label: Guard cells
fields.help: Cells skipped next to the cell under test.

fields.label: Divisor shift
fields.help: log2 of the noise-sum divisor (UG p.20: CA log2(2*window), CAGO/CASO log2(window)).

fields.label: Cyclic
fields.help: Wrap the window around the FFT edge.

fields.label: Threshold (raw)
fields.help: Raw log2 Q9 value written to the HWA, not dB: dB = raw * 6 / 512 * N'/N with N = RX x TX virtual antennas and N' the next power of two (the shipped 1280 is 15 dB for N = 8). Larger = fewer detections.

fields.label: Peak grouping, range
fields.help: Group neighbouring range detections (HWA).

fields.label: Peak grouping, Doppler
fields.help: Group neighbouring Doppler detections (software).

fields.label: Keep from range bin
fields.help: First range-bin index whose detections are kept (the filter applies even with grouping off).

fields.label: Keep to range bin
fields.help: Last range-bin index whose detections are kept; the shipped value tracks the cfg's range FFT size.

fields.label: Mode
fields.help: CFAR averaging: CA averages both sides, CAGO takes the greater side, CASO the smaller (better for adjacent targets).

fields.label: Noise window
fields.help: Noise cells averaged on each side of the cell under test (the UG calls it one-sided). 2*(window+guard) must stay below the number of FFT bins in that direction.

fields.label: Guard cells
fields.help: Cells skipped on each side of the cell under test so a target's own leakage does not raise the noise estimate.

fields.label: Divisor shift
fields.help: log2 of the noise-sum divisor: ceil(log2(2*window)) for CA, ceil(log2(window)) for CAGO/CASO. A mismatch is accepted by the firmware but rescales the threshold.

fields.label: Cyclic
fields.help: Wrap the window around the FFT edge. The DSP CFAR (IWR6843/ODS) ignores this (source-read, bench check pending).

fields.label: Threshold
fields.help: Detection threshold above the noise estimate in dB (0-100; the CLI rejects more, two decimals are kept). 0 switches the Doppler CFAR off on the IWR1843 HWA (source-read).

fields.label: Peak grouping
fields.help: Keep only the local maximum among neighbouring detections in this direction.

fov.help: Detections outside this window are dropped after CFAR. Auto follows the cfg's max range and +-max velocity; manual sets the window. Mandatory on this firmware (sensorStart fails without both directions).
